title: Alchemy Tales v3.0.0 Update Notes: World Sects and Sect Assault Are Live
author: Ok-Construction6990
selftext:
After about a week of testing and fixes, the new content is now live. We do not plan another major version update in the near term. The designed gameplay systems are largely complete, and we do not currently have new modes in mind. Follow-up work will focus on visuals, balance numbers, copy, and similar polish.

# New

# World Sects

* Publish the sect you built to the Steam Workshop; other players can subscribe, download, and import it as a stronghold on the world map.
* New world map and World Sect Ladder: explore to discover strongholds; defeating equal- or higher-rank strongholds can raise your sect’s global rank.

# Exploration & Assault

* Form exploration parties with disciples and warships to travel the world fog, reveal the map, and discover other sects.
* Assault discovered strongholds on the main map. Defeat the defenders and destroy the halls to take ladder rank and claim first-clear loot.

# Secret Realm

* Prep supports switching among cultivator types; different types have different damage bonuses and attack styles.
* Technique scrolls can drop in the Secret Realm; after learning them, cast according to the cultivator type locked for the run.

# Improvements

* Unified feature-unlock tips and assorted UI copy.
* Removed the entry-count limit on the main-menu leaderboards.
* Stronger Secret Realm and sect combat VFX, with Secret Realm floor-climbing numbers adjusted.
* Smoother sect scenes during large builds and exploration.
* Fixed other known issues.
